title: Daily payouts for high-volume merchants
executive_summary:
Direct answer: Ensure the new daily payouts read a live KYC status and settled balances from the Ledger, and prioritise tests that block payouts on unapproved KYC and validate ledger reconciliation, idempotency and refund postings — run TC-1159 (P0) plus the P1 ledger/reconciliation tests TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062, TC-1065, TC-1061, TC-1064 and TC-1166.  
Fact 1 — business/functional drivers: this change directly implements Merchant Payout Release and Merchant KYC Verification (REQ-1029, REQ-1031).  
Fact 2 — historical failure mode: a critical production defect released payouts from a cached KYC status (BUG-409), so live-KYC gating must be tested (covered by TC-1159).  
Fact 3 — ledger risk and decision: Ledger consistency and reconciliation are required (REQ-1008, REQ-1020), a ledger migration must ship in the same release (CMT-1022), and prior critical ledger bugs (e.g. BUG-171, BUG-294) justify running the recommended ledger tests TC-1060/TC-1066/TC-1062.

ecr_overview.title: Daily payouts for high-volume merchants
ecr_overview.description: Move high-volume merchants from weekly to daily payouts in the Merchant Payout Service. Payouts must read settled balances from the Ledger Service and a live KYC status from the KYC Verification Service.

change_classification.summary: ECR-2026-022 is a backend change in the Risk domain affecting KYC Verification. 2 file(s) are declared on the change and 3 candidate component(s) were identified.

matched_requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
matched_requirements.description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Merchant Payout Release
matched_requirements.description: The Merchant Payout Service shall release payouts only to merchants with an approved KYC status and only for settled ledger balances.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Merchant KYC Verification
matched_requirements.description: The KYC Verification Service shall verify merchant identity documents, reject expired documents and re-verify merchants every 12 months.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-026 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Financial Reconciliation Reporting
matched_requirements.description: A daily reconciliation report shall summarise settled, refunded and pending amounts per currency for finance operations.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-013 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Wallet Balance Integrity
matched_requirements.description: The Digital Wallet Service shall never allow a balance below zero, shall apply top-ups only after payment capture and shall post every balance movement to the ledger.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-022 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Ordered Payment Event Publishing
matched_requirements.description: Payment events shall be published on the Event Broker in transaction order and delivered at least once to the ledger and reporting consumers.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-031 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
matched_requirements.description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-023 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Refund Currency Parity
matched_requirements.description: Refunds shall be issued in the original transaction currency using the original conversion rate so that the customer is made whole.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, merchant.

matched_requirements.title: Loyalty Points Accrual
matched_requirements.description: The Loyalty Service shall award loyalty points only for completed orders and shall remove points when an order is cancelled or refunded.
matched_requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, move.

Wallet top-up message sent before capture

defect_summary: BUG-409, BUG-171, and BUG-408 are the most likely to happen again because they directly touch the services that ECR-2026-022 changes and all three reached production before. BUG-409 happened because the payout job read cached KYC status instead of fresh data, so the team should run TC-1159 and TC-1161 to verify KYC approval is checked fresh every time. BUG-171 and BUG-294 both involved ledger calculations for refunds, so the team should run TC-1060, TC-1066, and TC-1062 to confirm refunds use the correct exchange rates and are not double-counted. BUG-275 had no covering tests, which is why it reached production, so the team should verify that every authorisation call writes a transaction row before the code is released.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body:
Direct answer: Ensure the new daily payouts read a live KYC status and settled balances from the Ledger, and prioritise tests that block payouts on unapproved KYC and validate ledger reconciliation, idempotency and refund postings — run TC-1159 (P0) plus the P1 ledger/reconciliation tests TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062, TC-1065, TC-1061, TC-1064 and TC-1166.  
Fact 1 — business/functional drivers: this change directly implements Merchant Payout Release and Merchant KYC Verification (REQ-1029, REQ-1031).  
Fact 2 — historical failure mode: a critical production defect released payouts from a cached KYC status (BUG-409), so live-KYC gating must be tested (covered by TC-1159).  
Fact 3 — ledger risk and decision: Ledger consistency and reconciliation are required (REQ-1008, REQ-1020), a ledger migration must ship in the same release (CMT-1022), and prior critical ledger bugs (e.g. BUG-171, BUG-294) justify running the recommended ledger tests TC-1060/TC-1066/TC-1062.

sections.title: ECR Overview
sections.body: Move high-volume merchants from weekly to daily payouts in the Merchant Payout Service. Payouts must read settled balances from the Ledger Service and a live KYC status from the KYC Verification Service.

sections.title: Affected Requirements
sections.body: Searched 60 requirements across traceability, semantic and keyword channels and matched 10. Strongest match is REQ-1008 (Transaction Ledger Consistency) at 100% relevance.

requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
requirements.description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Merchant Payout Release
requirements.description: The Merchant Payout Service shall release payouts only to merchants with an approved KYC status and only for settled ledger balances.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Merchant KYC Verification
requirements.description: The KYC Verification Service shall verify merchant identity documents, reject expired documents and re-verify merchants every 12 months.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-026 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Financial Reconciliation Reporting
requirements.description: A daily reconciliation report shall summarise settled, refunded and pending amounts per currency for finance operations.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-013 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Wallet Balance Integrity
requirements.description: The Digital Wallet Service shall never allow a balance below zero, shall apply top-ups only after payment capture and shall post every balance movement to the ledger.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-022 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Ordered Payment Event Publishing
requirements.description: Payment events shall be published on the Event Broker in transaction order and delivered at least once to the ledger and reporting consumers.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-031 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
requirements.description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-023 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Refund Currency Parity
requirements.description: Refunds shall be issued in the original transaction currency using the original conversion rate so that the customer is made whole.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, merchant.

requirements.title: Loyalty Points Accrual
requirements.description: The Loyalty Service shall award loyalty points only for completed orders and shall remove points when an order is cancelled or refunded.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, move.

sections.title: Defect Analysis
sections.body: BUG-409, BUG-171, and BUG-408 are the most likely to happen again because they directly touch the services that ECR-2026-022 changes and all three reached production before. BUG-409 happened because the payout job read cached KYC status instead of fresh data, so the team should run TC-1159 and TC-1161 to verify KYC approval is checked fresh every time. BUG-171 and BUG-294 both involved ledger calculations for refunds, so the team should run TC-1060, TC-1066, and TC-1062 to confirm refunds use the correct exchange rates and are not double-counted. BUG-275 had no covering tests, which is why it reached production, so the team should verify that every authorisation call writes a transaction row before the code is released.

defects.title: Merchant payout released before KYC approval
defects.root_cause: Payout job read a cached KYC status.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Merchant Payout Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1029, REQ-1031, which this ECR also affects. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1159, TC-1161 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Ledger postings unbalanced for cross-currency refunds
defects.root_cause: Refund used live rate instead of the original transaction rate.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Ledger Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1014, REQ-1008, which this ECR also affects. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Authorisation succeeded but transaction row was never written
defects.root_cause: No outbox pattern between acquirer call and persistence.
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Payment Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1001, which this ECR also affects. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: No recommended test covers this. Check that the fix still holds: No outbox pattern between acquirer call and persistence.

defects.title: Ledger reconciliation job double-counted refunds
defects.root_cause: Join fan-out on the refund reversal table.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Ledger Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1008, REQ-1020, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Chargeback reversal posted twice to the ledger
defects.root_cause: Webhook retries were not de-duplicated.
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Chargeback Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1028, REQ-1008, which this ECR also affects. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Order total mismatch versus authorised amount
defects.root_cause: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Order Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1001, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: No recommended test covers this. Check that the fix still holds: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.

defects.title: Reporting extract timed out after transaction table growth
defects.root_cause: Missing composite index on (settled_at, currency).
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Reporting Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1020, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1145, TC-1146, TC-1149 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Payment events published out of order
defects.root_cause: Partition key used merchant id instead of transaction id.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1036, REQ-1008, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Fraud service latency spike blocked checkout
defects.root_cause: Synchronous screening without a fail-open policy.
defects.why_it_matters: Its description is similar to this change, but the change does not touch its code. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Currency service returned rates with wrong precision
defects.root_cause: Float rounding in the rate serialiser.
defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1008, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1060, TC-1066, TC-1062 to make sure it does not come back.

mitigations: Run the money-movement regression pack and reconcile ledger balances in a staging dry run before promoting.
Address the open review concern from hannah.pereira@enterprise.com.

trace.action: Understanding the ECR and planning the investigation
trace.detail: Classified as BACKEND_CHANGE (confidence 97%) from 1 signal groups. Extracted 12 technical keywords, 1 affected feature(s) and 1 risk indicator(s). Backend change with 1 risk indicator(s) detected. Gathering all evidence.

trace.action: Gathering requirements, code impact, history, comments and evidence
trace.detail: Searched 60 requirements across traceability, semantic and keyword channels and matched 10. Strongest match is REQ-1008 (Transaction Ledger Consistency) at 100% relevance. Parsed 18 modules (30 import edges) and resolved 1 changed module(s). Direct impact: CMP-015, CMP-024. 5 module(s) import the changed code, giving indirect impact on CMP-002, CMP-003, CMP-006, CMP-007, CMP-013. Searched 68 histo

trace.action: Understanding the ECR and gathering its evidence
trace.detail: Retrieved 10 requirements, 10 defects, 2 comments, 1 evidence for ECR-2026-022.

trace.action: Scoring risk and identifying impacted components
trace.detail: Risk score 77/100 (CRITICAL). Dependency Impact: 13 component(s) sit downstream of the change (dependency risk index 1.00). Historical Risk: 10 similar historical defect(s), 3 of them critical. Business Criticality: Most critical directly impacted component is rated CRITICAL; 10 linked requirement(s); strongest downstream exposure 0.55 after coupling discount.

trace.action: Selecting regression tests, linking evidence and analysing related defects
trace.detail: Discovered 154 unique candidate test(s) out of 170 commerce test(s): 34 via requirement traceability, 152 via component coverage and 25 via semantic search. Scored 154 candidate(s) against the impact model and selected 20 test(s) out of a 170-test regression suite (88.2% reduction). Estimated execution 50 minutes versus 424 minutes for the full suite. Ordered 20 test(s): 1 P0, 9 P1, 10 P2, 0 P3. P
